test_scenarios.name: Code Review - Security Vulnerability
test_scenarios.prompt: Review this authentication function for security issues, highlight any timing attacks, input validation gaps, and recommend mitigations with code snippets.

expected_characteristics.structure: systematic line-by-line review with bullet findings

test_scenarios.why_this_config: Code Review Precision sets temperature=0.2 and repeat_penalty=1.2 to keep findings deterministic while allowing sufficient context for detailed critiques.

test_scenarios.name: Code Generation - Feature Implementation
test_scenarios.prompt: Implement a REST endpoint that validates JWT tokens, logs suspicious payloads, and adheres to clean architecture principles. Include TypeScript types and test hooks.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Deterministic uses temperature=0.0 with a moderate top_p so code is consistent every run and logic stays tightly scoped.

test_scenarios.name: Debugging - Race Condition Trace
test_scenarios.prompt: You are debugging a multi-threaded queue consumer in Go that loses items under load. Diagnose the race condition, describe reproducible steps, and suggest code fixes.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Debugging Trace keeps temperature at 0.45 and num_predict=768 so the model elaborates multi-step reasoning without veering off-topic.

test_scenarios.name: Reasoning - Long-form System Analysis
test_scenarios.prompt: Analyze this distributed ledger proposal checking for single points of failure, throughput bottlenecks, and security trade-offs across consensus layers.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Longform Analyst extends context to 16K tokens and boosts analyze depth, enabling multi-section explanations of complex systems.

test_scenarios.name: Reasoning - Quick Logic Puzzle
test_scenarios.prompt: Solve this logic grid puzzle in minimal steps, explaining deductions succinctly and stating the final assignment table.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Socratic Reasoner uses temperature=0.6 and top_p=0.92 to encourage questions and verification while finishing quickly.

test_scenarios.name: Reasoning - Chain-of-Thought Comparison
test_scenarios.prompt: Compare two strategic approaches for scaling an AI assistant; outline assumptions, pros/cons, and reach a recommendation with a chain-of-thought log.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Brainstorm Burst’s high temperature/top_p encourages diverse rationale while still supporting structured chain-of-thought entries.

test_scenarios.name: Creative - Short Story Pitch
test_scenarios.prompt: Craft a short speculative fiction story about climate-positive cities, emphasizing character growth and futuristic sensory details.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Storyteller Rich’s temperature=1.1 and repeat_penalty=0.95 maximize expressive variation while maintaining coherence.

test_scenarios.name: Creative - Thematic Poetry
test_scenarios.prompt: Compose a lyrical poem about resilience in the face of automation, using internal rhyme and three stanzas with distinct moods.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Brainstorm Burst’s top_k=100 and high temperature surface serendipitous phrasing that poetry demands.

test_scenarios.name: Creative - Campaign Brainstorm
test_scenarios.prompt: Generate ten multimedia campaign ideas for an eco-education platform; include taglines, format, and audience hooks.

expected_characteristics.structure: numbered list with format and rationale

test_scenarios.why_this_config: Storyteller Rich balances vivid prose with enough structure to keep idea descriptions grounded.

test_scenarios.name: Factual - Comparative Research Brief
test_scenarios.prompt: Summarize the latest findings on battery recycling technologies, compare energy efficiency, and cite relevant standards.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Factual Fast keeps temperature low and tokens short to maximize accuracy and speed for data-heavy summaries.

test_scenarios.name: Factual - Executive Summary
test_scenarios.prompt: Read this 2,500-word report and produce a one-page executive summary that highlights key metrics, risks, and next steps.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Longform Analyst’s extended context retains the full report so summary statements align with source insights.

test_scenarios.name: Factual - Technical Writing
test_scenarios.prompt: Draft developer-facing documentation for a publish-subscribe streaming library, covering setup, architecture, and failure scenarios.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Deterministic ensures the docs always map to the same structure while still allowing multi-section depth.

test_scenarios.name: Conversational - Assistant Empathy
test_scenarios.prompt: Act as a career coach helping a mid-level engineer navigate burnout and propose realistic next steps.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Concise Assistant enforces brevity and clarity so the coach response stays focused and easy to digest.

test_scenarios.name: Conversational - Long-context Support
test_scenarios.prompt: Summarize the main action items from this 25-turn support conversation and propose a follow-up plan that references earlier context.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Extended Context retains 16K tokens so earlier conversation points inform the summary accurately.

test_scenarios.name: Conversational - Firm Guidance with Repetition Control
test_scenarios.prompt: Provide a firm but friendly reminder for users to complete onboarding steps without repeating phrases or rambling.
test_scenarios.why_this_config: Edge-Case Guard increases repeat_penalty so the response avoids redundancy while staying cautious and precise.
